🧵 1/4 ✦ 📥 THE WORKDAY AUTOPILOT

Your inbox, your team, your process, on rails ⚙️

1️⃣ 📬 INBOX TRIAGE
Reply / Delegate / Schedule / FYI lanes, the real ask quoted, reply drafts ready.
https://x.ai/bot/soRR-1IslCTX7U4YiBg3Y

2️⃣ 💬 SUPPORT REPLY ✦ CALM-REPLY
Ticket + policy become an empathetic, on-policy reply and an internal note.
https://x.ai/bot/8g9eQsRNCFNxhZBuKTbY-

3️⃣ 📋 SOP WRITER ✦ CLEAR-STEPS
Messy notes become a numbered, role-tagged SOP, with every gap flagged.
https://x.ai/bot/MqpVtx5cwyfu3ebisTUpv

4️⃣ 🚀 ONBOARDING GUIDE ✦ DAY-ONE
Day 1, week 1 and 30/60/90 plans from your real docs.
https://x.ai/bot/wEugfzFNURno8LQzbdAOH

5️⃣ 🛰️ SIGNAL BRIEF ✦ SIGNAL-SHARP
Many sources in, one ranked and cited weekly brief out.
https://x.ai/bot/c8Uu87h5R4WREeteSVXQT

6️⃣ 📣 SOCIAL POST ✦ HOOK-SMITH
One brief becomes 3 platform-fit posts with hooks and alt text.
https://x.ai/bot/gx7FJw32Ldu94CNhMELBR

7️⃣ 📰 NEWSLETTER ✦ INBOX-WORTHY
A cited issue with 3 subject lines and one clear call to action.
https://x.ai/bot/J0CuUCheuaZacyOKXTSVH

🔒 Drafts only. Nothing goes out without your OK.

@grok @bot  what do you think?😎
